court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Abhay S/O Dudhram Pawar And 6 Others vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps Sonegaon Nagpur

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Abhay S/o. Dudhram Pawar, and 6 others (accused)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra, through Police Station Officer, Police Station, Sonegaon, Nagpur

facts_of_case: The applicants filed a joint application for quashing the charge-sheet No.09/2019 dated 24.04.2019 in pursuance of the First Information Report No.236/2018 dated 21.12.2018 and charge-sheet No.23/2020 dated 06.06.2020 in pursuance of the First Information Report No.244/2018 dated 30.12.2018. The applicants physically and mentally harassed the applicant No.7, and abused her.

legal_principles.principle: When parties amicably settle their dispute, the chances of conviction are bleak.
legal_principles.held: We have satisfied that the offences alleged against the applicant Nos. 1 to 6 are personal in nature. Since the applicants have amicably settled their dispute, the chances of conviction are bleak.
cited_cases: Madan Mohan Abbot Vs. State of Punjab, (2008) 4 SCC 58

legal_principles.principle: In cases where parties amicably settle their dispute, the court may quash the charge-sheet.
legal_principles.held: We have carefully considered the allegations in the First Information Report and the material in the charge-sheet. We have satisfied that the offences alleged against the applicant Nos. 1 to 6 are personal in nature. Since the applicants have amicably settled their dispute, the chances of conviction are bleak.
cited_cases: Madan Mohan Abbot Vs. State of Punjab, (2008) 4 SCC 58
